title: Fundamentals of Recent Spate of En Bloc Property Sales
what_it_is: Fundamentals of Recent Spate of En Bloc Property Sales

sections.label: En bloc sale increase factors
sections.summary: The increase in en bloc sales is attributed to developers replenishing land banks and successful 2016 sales encouraging owners of ageing projects.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The recent increase in en bloc sales could be attributed to two factors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: First, more developers are keen to replenish their land banks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: To illustrate, there are about 17,200 units as at the third quarter of 2017, and that is down from about 40,000 units in 2012.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The second factor is that successful en bloc sales in 2016 may have encouraged more owners of ageing residential projects to initiate the en bloc sale process this year, so as to monetise their assets.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The en bloc sale sites sold since 2016 will be redeveloped and made available for sale in the next one to two years.

sections.label: GLS programme announcement timing
sections.summary: Details of the GLS programme for the first half of 2018 will be announced by the end of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Details of the GLS programme for the first half of 2018 will be announced by the end of this year.

sections.label: Developers subject to ABSD
sections.summary: Developers are subject to Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty and must build and sell units within five years of site award.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Bear in mind that developers are also subject to Additional Buyer’s Stamp Duty (ABSD), meaning to say that they have to build and sell their units within the five years of award of the site.

sections.label: En bloc units add supply
sections.summary: En bloc units will be redeveloped and put back into the market in the next one to two years, increasing supply.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: That would add new supply into the market.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, while there is this bid for en bloc sales now and supply conditions may be tight, eventually, all of the en bloc units will be redeveloped and put back into the market in the next one to two years, and that will increase supply in the market.
